children: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II reported a $70,027 net loss in the quarter, driven by $113,249 of operating and formation costs, partly offset by $43,222 of interest earned on Trust Account investments. The company had not commenced operations and generated no operating revenue.
: The company was formed to pursue a business combination and said it cannot assure that its plans will be successful.
: On September 28, the company completed its IPO of 17.25 million units, generating gross proceeds of $172.5 million.
: $173.4 million was held in the Trust Account at September 30, primarily in a money market fund investing in U.S. Treasury securities.
: The Sponsor committed on November 2 to fund operational and regulatory obligations until a business combination closes or one year from issuance of the financial statements.
